KXMLBALLSTAR.quote: is selected to the 2026 Pro Baseball American League All-Star Team
KXMLBALLSTAR.reason: Resolves on selection to the AL All-Star roster (fan ballot, player ballot, commissioner/replacement picks), and YES even if the player is selected but does not participate. A first-half honour driven by performance and popularity, not by the exhibition game itself, so it sits with awards/honours rather than All-Star week event props.

KXMLBALLSTARHR.quote: combined hit at least 7 home runs in the 2026 MLB All-Star Game
KXMLBALLSTARHR.reason: Total home runs by all players in the All-Star Game versus a threshold (7+). Generated by the exhibition format: one-inning pitcher rotations, all-star lineups, no stakes; not a regular-season hitter HR prop for one batter.

KXMLBASGAME.quote: If the National League All-Star team wins the Pro Baseball All-Star Game
KXMLBASGAME.reason: Winner of the NL vs AL All-Star Game with standard postponement (2-day) and fair-price cancellation rules. Exhibition roster and substitution patterns (and a possible swing-off tiebreak) make it distinct from a regular game moneyline.

KXMLBASGHIT.quote: has at least 1 Hit in the 2026 MLB All-Star Game
KXMLBASGHIT.reason: Named player 1+ hit in the All-Star Game; resolves NO if he does not enter the game and swing-off statistics are excluded. Limited plate appearances under exhibition substitution drive the outcome, unlike the regular hitter hits archetype.

KXMLBASGHR.quote: has at least 1 Home Run in the 2026 MLB All-Star Game
KXMLBASGHR.reason: Named player 1+ home run in the All-Star Game; NO if he does not enter, swing-off home runs do not count. One or two plate appearances against rotating elite relievers is an exhibition mechanism, not the hitter_home_runs per-game prop.

KXMLBASGKS.quote: has at least 2 strikeouts in the 2026 MLB All-Star Game
KXMLBASGKS.reason: Pitcher records 2+ strikeouts in the All-Star Game (NO if he does not enter). Exposure is typically one inning per pitcher, so the outcome is set by All-Star usage rather than starter workload as in pitcher_strikeouts.

KXMLBASGMVP.quote: wins the Pro Baseball All-Star Game MVP in the 2026 season
KXMLBASGMVP.reason: All-Star Game MVP, voted at the game on exhibition performance (usually a winning-league player with a big hit). Determined by the single exhibition game, not a season-long ballot, so filed with All-Star week events rather than season awards.

KXMLBDIVWINNER.quote: If a team in NL West division wins the pro men's baseball championship in the 2025 season
KXMLBDIVWINNER.reason: Despite the 'divisions' title, YES resolves if any team from the named division (NL West) wins the World Series championship. This is a postseason title future aggregated over a division's clubs, which is season_futures, not a division-standings market.

KXMLBDRAFTPICK.quote: is selected as the 5th overall pick in the 2026 Pro Baseball Draft
KXMLBDRAFTPICK.reason: Resolves on a prospect being taken at an exact draft slot (5th overall) in the MLB Draft. Outcome is set by club draft boards, the draft-lottery order, bonus-pool/signability and prior picks, a selection-ordering mechanism, not a trade/signing event.

KXMLBDRAFTTOP.quote: is drafted top 10 in the 2026 Pro Baseball Draft
KXMLBDRAFTTOP.reason: Resolves if a named prospect is selected within the top 10 picks of the MLB Draft; same draft-board/slot-value ordering mechanism as the exact-pick series, a cumulative version of it over pick positions 1-10.

KXMLBFODTEAMS.quote: is confirmed to be in the Pro Baseball 2027 Field of Dreams Game
KXMLBFODTEAMS.reason: Resolves on MLB announcing/confirming a club as a participant of the 2027 Field of Dreams special-event game; all NO if no game is announced. A league scheduling/event announcement, not game performance; in scope as an MLB decision, closest to announcement-settled off-field markets.

KXMLBFTGAME.quote: If the National League wins the Pro Baseball Futures Game
KXMLBFTGAME.reason: Winner of the NL vs AL prospects Futures Game during All-Star week (2-day postponement, fair-price cancellation). Exhibition with minor-league prospects and short pitcher stints; the All-Star week exhibition mechanism is closest, though the talent pool is minor-league.

KXMLBHRDERBY.quote: wins the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBY.reason: Home Run Derby winner; NO if the player does not participate, dead-heat 1/N on ties. Derby is a timed/pitch-limited bracket of home-run swings off batting-practice pitching, an All-Star week event, not in-game home runs.

KXMLBHRDERBY500.quote: record at least 6 500+ foot home runs at the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBY500.reason: Count of 500+ ft home runs across the whole Derby versus a threshold, using tracked distance. Depends on field composition, round structure, park/altitude and weather; an All-Star week Derby event total.

KXMLBHRDERBYDISTANCE.quote: record a home run of at least 525 feet at the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYDISTANCE.reason: Whether any Derby home run reaches 525+ feet, an extreme-of-distance outcome across all Derby swings measured by league tracking; generated by Derby swing volume, hitter power and park conditions.

KXMLBHRDERBYFIN.quote: qualifies for the Finals of the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYFIN.reason: Named player qualifies for the Derby final (NO if not participating). Driven by round-by-round HR totals and bracket/advancement rules of the Derby format.

KXMLBHRDERBYFORECAST.quote: goes head to head vs Munetaka Murakami in the final round and wins the 2026 Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYFORECAST.reason: Forecast: both named players must reach the Derby final and the selected one must win; NO if either misses the final or does not participate. A joint outcome of Derby advancement and final-round result.

KXMLBHRDERBYLONGEST.quote: records the longest home run by distance at the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYLONGEST.reason: Named player hits the longest Derby home run by league-measured distance; NO if not participating, dead-heat on ties. Depends on swings taken (rounds advanced) and raw power, a Derby event outcome.

KXMLBHRDERBYMATCHUP.quote: is the matchup for the final round of the 2026 Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYMATCHUP.reason: Resolves if the two named players form the Derby final-round matchup (NO if either does not participate). Determined by Derby round totals and seeding/bracket advancement.

KXMLBHRDERBYOU.quote: hits at least 7 home runs in Round 2 of the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYOU.reason: Named player's home-run count in Derby Round 2 versus a threshold; NO if he does not participate (and implicitly requires reaching Round 2). Timed-round swing volume and BP power drive it.

KXMLBHRDERBYQUAL.quote: is selected as a participant in the 2026 Pro Baseball Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYQUAL.reason: Resolves on the player being announced as a Derby participant, YES even if selected but not participating. Driven by player opt-in and MLB invitation (HR-leader status, star appeal, home-park ties), not performance; kept with All-Star week events as the Derby field-selection stage.

KXMLBHRDERBYR1LEAD.quote: hits the most home runs in the 1st round in the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYR1LEAD.reason: Named player has the most Round 1 Derby home runs (dead-heat 1/N on ties, NO if not participating). Single timed round across the full field.

KXMLBHRDERBYSEMI.quote: qualifies for Round 2 of the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYSEMI.reason: Named player advances to Derby Round 2 (NO if not participating). Advancement depends on Round 1 totals relative to the field under Derby qualification rules.

KXMLBHRDERBYTOT.quote: combined hit at least 140 home runs in the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYTOT.reason: Total home runs by all Derby participants versus a threshold (140+); driven by field size, round time/pitch limits, bonus time and park conditions.

KXMLBHRDERBYVELO.quote: records the highest exit velocity home run at the 2026 MLB Home Run Derby
KXMLBHRDERBYVELO.reason: Named player records the highest-exit-velocity Derby home run per league tracking; NO if not participating, dead-heat on ties. Extreme of a tracked measurement across Derby swings.

KXMLBNEXTHR.quote: hits a home run in an MLB game after May 26, 2026 and before Aug 1, 2026
KXMLBNEXTHR.reason: Named player hits at least one MLB home run in a ~9-week window; NO otherwise. A cumulative counting threshold over many games (dominated by availability/injury and HR rate), which is the counting-specials mechanism rather than a single-game HR prop.

KXMLBRETURN.quote: must enter a game for the Tigers after May 8, 2026 and before June 8, 2026
KXMLBRETURN.reason: Resolves YES if the named player enters a game for the Tigers within a date window (injury return). Outcome is set by injury recovery, rehab assignment and activation timing, i.e. player participation/availability.

KXMLBSERIESEXACT.quote: results in the following series record: Toronto win 4-3
KXMLBSERIESEXACT.reason: Exact best-of-7 series result (Toronto wins 4-3) in the World Series; a function of the game-by-game series path, home-field pattern and rotation, the playoff-series mechanism.

KXMLBSERIESGAMETOTAL.quote: results in at least 7 games played
KXMLBSERIESGAMETOTAL.reason: Whether the 2025 championship series lasts at least 7 games; total games of a best-of-7 depends on per-game win probabilities and series path, the playoff-series mechanism, not a run total.

KXMLBSISTREAK.quote: records 70+ consecutive scoreless innings from the start of his streak
KXMLBSISTREAK.reason: Pitcher's consecutive scoreless innings streak reaching 70+ (partial innings in 1/3 units) before it is broken or the regular season ends. A cumulative counting threshold with an absorbing break (any run allowed); closest is counting specials, though survival-type dynamics are distinct.

KXMLBSTGAME.quote: wins the Cleveland vs Arizona professional baseball game originally scheduled for Mar 24, 2026
KXMLBSTGAME.reason: Spring Training game winner with 2-day postponement and fair-price cancellation rules. Game-winner mechanism as moneyline, but exhibition lineups, pitcher limits and possible ties/shortened games are not addressed in the rules text.

KXMLBTRADE.quote: The trade must be officially processed and approved by MLB before Aug 5, 2026
KXMLBTRADE.reason: Resolves YES if the named player is traded and the trade is officially processed and approved by MLB before the deadline date; stays YES if rescinded later. Classic transactions mechanism.

KXMLBWORLD.quote: If Chinese Taipei wins the World Baseball Classic
KXMLBWORLD.reason: World Baseball Classic tournament winner (national teams). Run by MLB/MLBPA with largely MLB players but not MLB competition; scope uncertain, kept IN scope as a tournament-winner future per the when-unsure rule. No tie/void details in rules.

amateur_draft_selection.label: MLB Draft pick position markets
amateur_draft_selection.target: Whether a named prospect is selected at an exact overall pick or within the top N picks of the MLB Draft.
amateur_draft_selection.why_distinct: Outcome is the ordering of prospects across sequential club selections (draft-lottery order, team boards, bonus-pool slot values, signability, picks ahead), whereas transactions models whether a single trade/signing/coaching event happens by a date and awards are voted honours.
